mapper.sql: select f.flow_id, f.dealer_id, f.flow_date, f.material_id, f.batch_no, f.quantity, f.downstream_type, f.downstream_name, f.shipment_id, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, c.customer_name as dealer_name, wms_m.material_name, wms_m.spec_model, wms_m.unit, wms_m.is_batch_manage, s.shipment_no from mk_dealer_sell_flow f left join mk_customer c on f.dealer_id = c.customer_id left join wms_material wms_m on f.material_id = wms_m.material_id left join mk_shipment s on f.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
mapper.select: select s.shipment_id, s.customer_id as dealer_id, oi.material_id, wms_m.material_name, d.batch_no, d.ship_qty as quantity from mk_shipment_detail d inner join mk_shipment s on d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id inner join mk_order_item oi on d.order_item_id = oi.item_id left join wms_material wms_m on oi.material_id = wms_m.material_id where d.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into mk_dealer_sell_flow (dealer_id, flow_date, material_id, batch_no, quantity, downstream_type, downstream_name, shipment_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{dealerId}, #{flowDate}, #{materialId}, #{batchNo}, #{quantity}, #{downstreamType}, #{downstreamName}, #{shipmentId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete:
delete from mk_dealer_sell_flow where flow_id in
#{flowId}
